system.description:
In order to cast this jutsu you must have a creature marked with the Sealing Art: Chakra Seal ninjutsu, that you cast.

You telepathically become aware of all creatures, objects and structures marked with Sealing Art: Chakra Seal and choose which one you want to focus on. By spending 10 feet of your remaining movement on your turn, you teleport into a space adjacent to the creatures, object or structure marked, as close as possible to the actual seals placement, so long as they are within 1 mile of you. This teleportation happens before any other effect is applied.

Once per turn, if you would teleport within 5 feet of a hostile creature, you have advantage on the next attack roll made against the creature until the end of your next turn.

You can teleport this way to a seal twice, after which, the seal is dispelled.
